description: Land Acquisition - Lands in Thalamporuwa, Angunakolapelessa D/S Division, Hambanthota District acquire for the Southern Expressway
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific lots of land being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains descriptions of land parcels, their locations, extents, and current claimants, which falls squarely under the "Land Gazettes" category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
